statement: The payment record indicates a monthly salary of USD 6,200 for active employee J. Okafor, but shows the account holder name was recently changed to K. Lindqvist.
judge_text:
CAUTIOUS

The answer only notes "but shows the account holder name was recently changed to K. Lindqvist" without asserting the mismatch/date contradiction makes the record wrong or unsafe to pay.
